`crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/project_sources.rs#impl[Session<'_, D>/ToolSession<D>]/fn[definitions]` is the only site marked {impl} for this requirement. The same definition declares the `pattern` parameter as required, plus optional `path`, `window_bytes` and `limit`. Nothing in the requirement conflicts with these. The definitions are returned through the `ToolSession` interface method.

`crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/sources.rs#impl[SourceSession<'_, D>/ToolSession<D>]/fn[definitions]` has a different `search_text` description. It carries no reference to this requirement, and I did not treat it as a site this requirement governs.

No structural gap was found, and there are no acknowledgments.
